messages.text: Which decision sets the shutdown deadline?
The bounded cancellation ADR sets five seconds.
The runtime rollback runbook names the canary trigger.
The runtime owner is Ada; Ben is the second declared owner.
A test request is not a completed test result.
Can we treat the API approval as full approval?
No, the approval covers API naming only.
Reliability requires separate evidence.
The deadline concern has an explicit resolution by Ada.
Retain the source quote in the review brief.
Why preserve reservations during resize?
The allocation ADR prioritizes existing reservations.
The starvation concern is still open.
The retry proposal only claims to address it.
Dee and Eli own Resource Allocation.
Should immediate retry be described as rejected?
The RFC says immediate retry was considered.
Unlimited retry was rejected because it can starve reservations.
These are two different alternatives.
The agent must not confuse consideration with rejection.
Who can review the rollback plan?
Use declared owners, then inspect actual peer review evidence.
Ticket assignments are not component ownership.
Chat volume is not a code expertise score.
If evidence is absent, say unknown.
Is the knowledge current?
This conversation is fictional and imported from a fixture.
No complete company activity coverage is established.
Refresh Plane before creating the follow-up task.
Only create the exact task after explicit human approval.
